label: The Reserved Interval
scope: 426 surface days of deliberately unwritten ground
rule: USER RULED 2026-09-19: SUSPENDED. Nothing inside the interval advances until it is played. No clock ticks, no profit accrues, no scheduled event fires by the passage of time alone. Play in the interval moves state; the calendar does not.
notes: Carved out on purpose to leave playable ground between the empire material and the Hell operation. Suspension is what keeps it worth playing - see rule:no-auto-accrual.

label: Unplayed time accrues nothing
rule: While SUSPENDED, elapsed calendar time produces no operating profit, no clock advance, no construction progress and no neglect degradation. Only played sessions move state.
notes: The ruling that matters most financially. At the shelf the empire runs a ~400,000 gp liquidity gap against a protected 450,000 target. Twelve months at 75-90K/mo profit would close it unattended. Suspension keeps the crisis live and makes it worth playing.

label: The interval may not invalidate the Crossing
rule: Sessions played in the interval may add texture, consequence, relationships and money. They may NOT invalidate any state already true at the Crossing or downstream of it.
notes: This is the rule the gap was carved out to protect. Without it the prequel can break the operation it was made for.

label: What the interval hands to the Crossing
rule: Money, entity state, headcount, ownership, loans, reputations and NPC dispositions carry forward. The Crossing inherits whatever the interval leaves.

label: What the interval may not touch
scope: Arik's position, kit at crossing, Hell-op preconditions
rule: Arik's location, his equipment at the moment of crossing, and the operation's stated preconditions are frozen. The interval steers toward them, never away.

label: Other lanes are not this interval
rule: Shi'van runs Day 911 / 6 Mirtul 1494. Jörmun runs ~Uktar 1498. Menzoberranzan is 1501/1570, ruled far-future and not a current lane. None of these are inside the Reserved Interval and none are governed by its suspension.
notes: A 1498 stamp on an entity is the Jörmun lane, not boundary leakage from this one.
